import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_factorial_budget (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (hn : 4 ≤ n) : m * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial n := by
  have h₁ : ∀ k : ℕ, 4 ≤ k → k * (k + 1) + k ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial k := by
    intro k hk
    induction' hk with k hk IH
    · 
      norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    · 
      cases k with
      | zero => contradiction 
      | succ k' =>
        cases k' with
        | zero => contradiction 
        | succ k'' =>
          cases k'' with
          | zero => contradiction 
          | succ k''' =>
            cases k''' with
            | zero => contradiction 
            | succ k'''' =>
              simp_all [Nat.factorial, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.pow_succ]
              <;> ring_nf at *
              <;> nlinarith [Nat.factorial_pos k'''']
  have h₂ : m * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial n := by
    have h₃ : n ≥ 4 := hn
    have h₄ : m ≤ n := hmn
    have h₅ : m * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ n * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 := by
      have h₅₁ : m ≤ n := hmn
      have h₅₂ : m * (n + 1) ≤ n * (n + 1) := by
        exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n + 1) h₅₁
      have h₅₃ : m * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ n * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 := by
        omega
      exact h₅₃
    have h₆ : n * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial n := by
      have h₆₁ : ∀ k : ℕ, 4 ≤ k → k * (k + 1) + k ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial k := h₁
      have h₆₂ : 4 ≤ n := hn
      have h₆₃ : n * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial n := by
        apply h₆₁
        exact h₆₂
      exact h₆₃
    omega
  exact h₂

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_factorial_budget (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (hn : 4 ≤ n) : m * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial n := by
  have hpred : n - 2 ≤ Nat.factorial (n - 2) := by
    exact Nat.self_le_factorial (n - 2)
  
  have hmul :
      (n - 1) * (n - 2) ≤ (n - 1) * Nat.factorial (n - 2) := by
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left (n - 1) hpred
  
  have hsub1 : n - 1 = n - 2 + 1 := by
    omega
  
  have hsub2 : n = n - 2 + 2 := by
    omega
  
  have hgrowth : n + 1 ≤ Nat.factorial (n - 1) := by
    have hrec :
        (n - 1) * Nat.factorial (n - 2) = Nat.factorial (n - 1) := by
      exact Nat.mul_factorial_pred (by omega)
    rw [← hrec]
    nlinarith [hmul]
  
  have hfact :
      n * Nat.factorial (n - 1) = Nat.factorial n := by
    exact Nat.mul_factorial_pred (by omega)
  
  have hpoly : n ^ 2 + n ≤ Nat.factorial n := by
    calc
      n ^ 2 + n = n * (n + 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ n * Nat.factorial (n - 1) :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left n hgrowth
      _ = Nat.factorial n := hfact
  
  have hmain :
      m * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ n * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 := by
    gcongr
  
  nlinarith [hpoly, hmain]

theorem bounded_factorial_budget (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (hn : 4 ≤ n) : m * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial n := by

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_factorial_budget (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (hn : 4 ≤ n) : m * (n + 1) + n ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial n := by
  have hfac : ∀ k : ℕ, 4 ≤ k → 3 * k ^ 2 ≤ 2 * Nat.factorial k := by
    intro k hk
    induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
    | base =>
        norm_num [Nat.factorial]
    | succ k hk ih =>
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
        have hk_sq : k + 1 ≤ k ^ 2 := by
          have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right k (show 2 ≤ k by omega)
          nlinarith [hmul]
        have hpoly :=
          Nat.mul_le_mul_left (k + 1)
            (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 3 hk_sq)
        have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (k + 1) ih
        nlinarith [hpoly, hmul]
  
  have hfacn := hfac n hn
  have hmn' : m * (n + 1) ≤ n * (n + 1) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n + 1) hmn
  have hn_sq : n ≤ n ^ 2 := by
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right n (show 1 ≤ n by omega)
    nlinarith [hmul]
  nlinarith [hfacn, hmn', hn_sq]
